photos.title: Photos
photos.empty_hint: Add one by its link. It will be here on every computer you use.
photos.capped: Showing your %s most recent. Anything older is still on your phone.
photos.video_missing: This video can't be played here.
photos.empty_hint_phone: Add one by its link, or take one with your phone.
photos.empty_phone: Photos and videos you take with your phone show up here.
photos.add_hint: Add a picture by its link
photos.add_body: Paste the link to a picture. It is kept with your pictures, on every computer you use.
photos.full: Your pictures are full (%s). Delete one first.
photos.pick_hint: Choose one of your pictures, or add a new one by its link.
photos.pick_empty: You have no pictures yet. Add one by its link below.

phonelink.title: Link your phone
phonelink.intro: See what is on your phone from this computer. Link it once and it stays linked here until you unlink it.
phonelink.unlocks_title: What you get on this computer
phonelink.unlock_notes_hint: Your phone's notes, kept in step
phonelink.send: Send a code to my phone
phonelink.no_phone_title: Your phone is not on you
phonelink.no_phone_body: The code goes to your phone, so you need it with you.
phonelink.sent_body: A %s-digit code was sent to your phone as a notification. Type it in here.
phonelink.sent_away: You can leave this computer to look: the code is still good when you come back.
phonelink.expired_body: Send a new one to carry on.
phonelink.linked_toast: Your phone is linked to this computer.
phonelink.away_title: Your phone is not on you
phonelink.away_body: This computer is still linked. Your phone's apps come back the next time you sign in with it on you.
phonelink.unlink_body: Your phone's apps will go from this computer. Nothing on the phone changes, and you can link it again with a new code.
phonelink.unlinked_toast: Your phone is no longer linked to this computer.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.empty_hint: Contacts you add here are saved to your phone, and the ones on your phone show up here.
contacts.select_hint: Pick a contact from the list, or add a new one.
contacts.edit_on_phone: Names, photos and other details are edited on your phone.
contacts.delete_on_phone: This card has no number, so it can only be deleted on your phone.
contacts.number_hint: It has to be a number that's in service.
contacts.err_name: Enter a name for the contact.
contacts.err_number: Enter a phone number of %s to %s digits.
contacts.delete_body: "%s" will be deleted from your phone too. This can't be undone.

cameras.title: Security Cameras
cameras.count: %s cameras you can watch from this computer
cameras.empty_body: There is no camera you may watch from this computer.
cameras.no_picture: A camera's picture only shows in the game.

print.title: Print
print.hint: The pages wait in the printer's tray. Walk over and take them.
print.none_body: There is no printer close enough to this computer.
print.sent_one: One page. Take it from the printer's tray.
print.sent_many: %s pages. Take them from the printer's tray.
print.faded_body: This page has faded with age. Nothing on it can be read any more.
print.save_first: Save the document to print it
print.sign_saved: This is your signature. It goes on the line with your name and the time under it.
print.sign_kept: It is kept as your signature, for every page you sign after this one.
print.sign_empty: Draw or type a signature first.
print.sign_failed: The page could not be signed.
